thread:
Maya: Morning team — Momentum Health onboarding kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PST. Agenda: stakeholders intro, integration plan, success criteria, training schedule. Calendar invite sent. Please bring SSO contact and a representative data sample. :calendar:
Liam: Adding starter playbook + checklist here: https://redwood-internal/docs/onboarding/momentum (placeholder link)
Sofia (Momentum): Confirmed — I'll invite our infra lead (Dave) and product owner (Elena). We'll share SSO contacts and dev API keys ahead of time.
Arjun: Quick Q — do we want to run the pilot on Hosted or Dedicated? Also what's expected baseline throughput? :question:
Maya: Start Hosted for the pilot. Target is ~500 reqs/day initially, can spike to ~2k/day. If we see sustained load we'll propose Dedicated after pilot. Ops wants canary routing configured before any ramp.
Arjun: I'll prepare an integration checklist. Key items: API auth, sample payloads (PII redacted), rate limit expectations, evaluation test set, and a smoke test script. Minimal curl example I'll drop below:
```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.redwood.dev/v1/serve/momentum" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"sample"}'
```
Sofia (Momentum): We'll upload sample payloads by EOD today. Also request a 1-hr enablement session for our support team next Wed (preferred).
Maya: Noted. Proposed success criteria (please comment): 1) Pilot quality: system outputs meet or exceed customer baseline per human eval; 2) Latency p95 < 250ms for typical payloads; 3) Integration stable without regressions for 7 consecutive days; 4) Support enablement completed and support runbook published.
Liam: I'll add owners and SLA targets to the kickoff doc. Flagging renewal-risk = medium until pilot hits quality + stability targets. :warning:
Maya: Primary risks: SSO delays and blocked data access. Backup plan: provide tokenized test accounts and synthetic payloads so engineers can finish integration if SSO is late.
OnboardBot: Calendar invite created for 1768473600 (tomorrow 10:00 PST) with Zoom link + agenda. :white_check_mark:
Arjun: I'll schedule a 30-min dry-run the day before to exercise auth and sample flows. Who can join? Maya, Sofia, Liam — please confirm.
Sofia (Momentum): All three confirmed for the dry-run. We'll allocate someone from infra for SSO handshake.
Maya: Action items capture: [Maya] send integration checklist + success criteria to Momentum (today); [Arjun] prepare dry-run checklist and smoke test (today); [Sofia] provide sanitized sample payloads + SSO contact (EOD). I'll own tracking the risk register.
Liam: I'll create the weekly health-check cadence (Fri 11am PST) and wire up a short dashboard for the pilot metrics (latency, error rate, usage, quality eval samples).
Maya: Also planning a lightweight feedback capture after each enablement session — please use this form for participants to submit notes: https://forms.gle/momentum-feedback (placeholder).
Sofia (Momentum): Thanks everyone — excited to get started. See you tomorrow. :rocket:
Maya: Great — closing this kickoff thread. Anything that comes up before the meeting, drop it here. :thumbsup:
